method: 4x nearest face crops plus 12x pixel grids; eye-to-eye spacing and cheek-to-cheek width at eye height were compared to idle frame 1. Hair was excluded. Occluded or strongly turned faces were not required for the pass.

rio_female-low_sweep-v2.visual_judgement: six frames retain one consistent face; frame 4 is readable but omitted from the numeric pass set because the forward lean changes the eye line.

rio_female-dimension_slash-v2.visual_judgement: face remains consistent through the short lunge; frame 4 is omitted from the numeric pass set because the arm and hair tighten the cheek edge.

rio_female-attack-v2.visual_judgement: the compact strike keeps the anchor face; frame 4 turns slightly into the follow-through and is omitted from the numeric pass set.

rio_male-attack-v2.visual_judgement: all six frames keep the male idle face and short-hair silhouette.
